hooks.command:
echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "Tool rules (always apply, no exceptions):
- JSON: use jq for all JSON processing (parsing, filtering, transforming, querying). Never use python3 -c, perl, or awk as a substitute.
- Task runner: the taskfile.dev binary on this system is go-task, not task. Always run go-task instead of task.
- File finding: always use `fd`, never `find` (bare find, /bin/find, /usr/bin/find, etc. are all hard-blocked by a PreToolUse hook -- using find wastes a full turn on the denial+retry, so reach for fd from the start, no exceptions). Same hook also blocks `fd`/`rg`/recursive `grep` targeting the literal filesystem root (/) -- any other path (/etc, ../../.., etc.) is fine, just never search the whole filesystem."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Memory MCP (mcp__memory__*) is the shared store for durable cross-session facts. At session start, memory_search for the current project/topic before non-trivial work. When the user states a durable preference, decision, or gotcha, memory_store it with metadata.tags (project name + type), not top-level tags. Behavior rules that must load every session stay in MEMORY.md files, not the MCP."}}'

sh -c '[ -n "$AOE_INSTANCE_ID" ] || exit 0; [ -n "$AOE_HOOK_BIN" ] || exit 0; [ -x "$AOE_HOOK_BIN" ] || exit 0; "$AOE_HOOK_BIN" __extract-session-id --field session-id 2>/dev/null; exit 0 # aoe-hooks'

sh -c 'unset IFS; set -f; umask 077; [ -n "$AOE_INSTANCE_ID" ] || exit 0; case "$AOE_INSTANCE_ID" in *[!0-9a-zA-Z_-]*) exit 0 ;; esac; B=/tmp/aoe-hooks-1000; mkdir -p "$B" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; LS=$(LC_ALL=C ls -ldn "$B" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; set -- $LS; M="$1"; case "$M" in drwx------|drwx------.|drwx------+|drwx------@) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ME=$(id -u 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$3" = "$ME" ] || exit 0; D="$B/$AOE_INSTANCE_ID"; mkdir -p "$D" 2>/dev/null; LS=$(LC_ALL=C ls -ldn "$D" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; set -- $LS; M="$1"; case "$M" in drwx------|drwx------.|drwx------+|drwx------@) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ "$3" = "$ME" ] || exit 0; printf waiting > "$D/status" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 # aoe-hooks'
